messages:
nina: running into a blocker with the python async SDK and our Dedicated VPC. sync client talks to the private base_url fine, async fails with SSL verify error.

emily: can you paste the error and how you're providing certs?

nina: error: `ssl.SSLCertVerificationError: certificate verify failed: unable to get local issuer certificate` coming from httpx async stack. I set SSL_CERT_FILE in the container and also tried REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE. sync client (requests) honors them.

kevin: thanks. quick summary: sync constructor has `ca_bundle` and falls back to env vars; async constructor currently doesn't expose that and builds a context from certifi in some codepaths. we've had a few customers hit this.

paul: i can repro locally. raw httpx.AsyncClient(verify='/etc/ssl/customer-ca.pem') works, so it's definitely the wrapper.

nina: minimal snippet that fails:```py
from redwood import AsyncClient
client = AsyncClient(api_key="x", base_url="https://redwood.private.internal")
await client.generate("hi")
```
no kwarg to pass the CA bundle.

emily: proposed fixes: (1) add `ca_bundle: Optional[Union[str, Path]]` to AsyncClient and forward as `verify` to httpx; (2) if not provided, check SSL_CERT_FILE and REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE env vars; (3) fallback to certifi if nothing else; (4) update type hints so mypy accepts `ca_bundle` and common httpx params.

kevin: extra behavioral change: our retry middleware currently retries on transport errors, including underlying SSL exceptions, which floods logs and hides the real issue. suggest default `retry_on_ssl = false` so SSLCertVerificationError surfaces immediately. we can make it opt-in for users who want retries.

paul: +1. also add a short troubleshooting snippet in Dedicated docs showing how to verify CA chain with httpx or openssl before contacting support. e.g. `python -c "import httpx; httpx.get('https://redwood.private.internal', verify='/etc/ssl/customer-ca.pem')"` and `openssl s_client -connect redwood.private.internal:443 -CAfile /etc/ssl/customer-ca.pem`.

ci-bot: opened issue #5399: "py-sdk: async client ca_bundle + env fallback + disable ssl retry by default" linking this thread.

kevin: i'll take this up. plan for PR: small API additive change (kwarg only), unit tests for precedence (explicit > env > certifi), mypy tests, and a retry test asserting SSLCertVerificationError is non-retriable by default. will include docs snippet for Dedicated quickstart.

emily: tiny note on typing: avoid `**kwargs` catch-all if we can; instead add explicit optional types for common httpx params and the ca_bundle param so autocompletion is friendly. add a changelog entry about the new param and the retry behavior.

nina: thanks 44d that'll unblock our deploy. ping here when the PR is up and i'll validate in our VPC.
